primary_mechanism_population: independently reconstructed operational >=10 MeV, >=10 pfu threshold-overlap positive windows from the pinned event catalog
reason: Multiplicity and onset-versus-persistence are physical-event mechanisms. The public stored Future_OSEP_label is audited separately and is not allowed to define the primary mechanism gate if it disagrees with the independently reconstructed event intervals.
primary_episode_multiplicity_factor: number of reconstructed positive windows that map uniquely to one physical episode divided by the number of distinct physical episodes represented by those windows
primary_persistence_count: reconstructed positive windows whose issue time lies inside exactly one physical threshold episode
primary_new_onset_count: reconstructed positive windows not already active at issue time with exactly one physical threshold episode beginning in (issue, issue+24h]
stored_target_analysis: Future_OSEP_label is retained unchanged, cross-tabulated against reconstructed interval occurrence, and receives separate stored-positive mapping/multiplicity descriptors; discrepancies do not alter physical episode definitions.
primary_gate_unchanged: strong confirmation requires reconstructed EMF >= 1.5 and reconstructed persistence windows > reconstructed new-onset windows
